recognize_zh: 高倍骨髓切片中，一群胞質豐富淡粉紅、核呈卵圓或拖鞋狀的上皮樣組織球聚在一起，箭頭指的是含多個核的多核巨細胞，周圍夾雜淋巴球，看不到壞死，符合非乾酪性肉芽腫。
features: Aggregate of epithelioid histiocytes with abundant pale eosinophilic cytoplasm and indistinct cell borders
Oval to elongated, slipper-shaped vesicular nuclei with fine chromatin and small nucleoli
Multinucleated giant cell (arrow) with several peripheral/clustered nuclei
Admixed small lymphocytes, plasma cells and occasional eosinophils at the periphery
No caseous necrosis in this field; adjacent fat spaces and hematopoietic cells
describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy (H&E) at high power shows an aggregate of epithelioid histiocytes with abundant pale eosinophilic cytoplasm and oval to slipper-shaped vesicular nuclei, including a multinucleated giant cell (arrow). Small lymphocytes, plasma cells and occasional eosinophils surround the aggregate. Necrosis is not identified in this field. Findings are consistent with a non-necrotizing epithelioid granuloma of the bone marrow; AFB and fungal stains, cultures and clinical correlation (infection, sarcoidosis, drugs, lymphoma) are recommended.

ddx.vs: Lipogranulomas are small, contain central lipid vacuoles surrounded by foamy macrophages and lymphocytes, and are usually incidental.
Hodgkin involvement shows Reed-Sternberg/Hodgkin cells with huge nucleoli that are CD30/CD15-positive among the histiocytes.
Megakaryocytes have a single hyperlobated nucleus and granular cytoplasm and lie among hematopoietic cells rather than within an epithelioid aggregate.
